summary: Bending Spoons S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a new €500 million SACE-backed term loan facility, plus €495 million term loan A financing and a €490 million revolving credit facility increase, totaling €1.49 billion in new/expanded facilities since Q2. These facilities mature in March 2031 and are for general corporate purposes and acquisitions. No specific acquisition target, divestiture, or special-situation event is announced. The filing is a routine financing update, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer. No deal terms are stated for any acquisition or other event.
